name: infernal_axeman
description: an Infernal Axeman, a red-skinned demon soldier: a black horned helmet with gold trim and two curved dark horns, a red face with yellow eyes in the helmet opening, black spiked plate armour with gold trim over bare red upper arms, a hanging red loincloth, black armoured boots, a red devil's tail curling out behind him on the screen-left side, and a big black battle axe with a flaming orange-edged crescent blade, gripped by the end of its haft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the axe's haft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the haft higher up, below the blade, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the haft, the black battle axe is lifted beside the horned helmet with its flaming blade pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the axe hand behind the head and the black battle axe's flaming blade hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the axe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the black battle axe is level, its flaming blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the battle axe's flaming blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the battle axe carries on down until its flaming blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red tail and the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the black battle axe comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the left hand reaching for the haft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the horned helmet snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (axe arm thrown up and out to the left, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the black battle axe dipping, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, axe arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the horned helmet droops, the battle axe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the battle axe's flaming blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the battle axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the red tail flopping
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the horned helmet on his head; the black battle axe lies on the ground at the lower-right, the flames on its blade dying; the red tail limp beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red loincloth settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes dark, the black battle axe on the ground beside him
